Dialog: Morning, Agent P, We have a report that Doofenshmirtz is at the Shark. We don't know which Shark, but it sounds bad. Ugh! Gives me the heebie-jeebies just thinking about it...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (On radio) Agent P, your halo jump is a go. Go, go, go! Jump, and fall! Keep falling, and keep being a platypus! Visualize it, you're a falling plat- (Perry turns off radio)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I see you got the memo. It's Transcendental Meditation Week. Namasté. (He bows and Perry bows back.) Doofenshmirtz has been spot—Carl, enough with the drumming!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, there you are. Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted playing with a hoop. See what he's up to. (Perry looks scornfully at Monogram.) That's it. That's all we got.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oui, Fifi. (at himself) Oh, now I've lost my train of thought. (at Perry) Anyway, get out to Doof's place and put a stop to it. (at Carl) How much is this costing us, Carl?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Gentlemen, we're out to stop Doofenwitch. You want to rescue the girl. I see an opportunity for some inter-agency cooperation. Now, here's the plan. Wait, why am I a fairy?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's not why I called you in. Get a look at this. This is Newton the Gnu. He was assigned to Dr. Diminutive, but it seems some bonehead blew his cover on the blogosphere.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, yes-yes, of course. Bad news is the relocation, and the good news is the new villain thing. Uh...just make sure you take your belongings from the house when you leave.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh-oh, sorry Agent P. I guess evil never takes a holiday. If you'll direct your attention to the screen. Good morning Agent P. A wise man once said... eyes on the screen.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly, Carl! This could bring down the entire organization. (straightens his mustache) Get him back to headquarters right away so we can restore his memory.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, good morning, Agent P. Uh...beat it, Carl. I'm on. (Carl leaves) Sources tell us that Doofenshmirtz's "ROTFL". We don't know what that means, but it sounds dangerous.

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh, you're from another dimension? Well then, he'll probably want to see you, he's into that freaky sorta stuff. Have a seat and I'll let him know you're on your way up.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Lucky dog. It's cold in... Oh! Agent P! Didn't hear you come in. I have no idea what Doofenshmirtz is up to. It seems all of our computers froze. Isn't that right, Carl?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, an unusual power wave has struck the city with potentially disastrous consequences. Forget Doofenshmirtz, find the source of that power wave, and dismantle it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry you had to pull that all-nighter, but we really appreciate you filling in for Agent Q. With most everyone at Agent-Con this week, we're, uh, a little shorthanded.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, yes, here it is. Dr. Doofenshmirtz. Huh, what a surprise. Building some sort of destructo ray. End of the world. Yada, yada, yada. I'm faxing you the coordinates.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! Anyway, we need you to find out what he's up to and put a stop to it. (Perry salutes) Good luck, Agent P. (The chopper comes out of his seat and he flies away.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay then, let's throw it over to my partner in crime. Not that I would perpetrate a crime with him of course, I'd never... (at Carl) Carl! Who wrote these cue cards?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, there you are, Agent P. Well, let's get down to brass tacks... (reading his clipboard) What's this? "Happy passive-agressive relationship day"? Oh, is that today?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, as you know, my father was in the agency, and what you don't know is that he pressured me into following in his footsteps. But I always wanted to be an acrobat!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (from inside) Alright everybody, tall kids in the back. (zooms to the inside of the lab) Just need to do a little more programming here, and we'll be ready to roll.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P. Look, here's the thing, I don't know what Doof is up to. I've been busy giving each of my friends personalized ring-tones. I have one for you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (On Perry's motorcycle's side mirror) Agent P. We've just received word that you're on Canadian soil. We don't have jurisdiction there. Stand down! That's an order!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, in focus group tests, 6-year-olds overwhelming preferred singing animals to a piece of paper with numbers on it, so I-- (Clears throat) Anyway, your mission

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, there you are, Agent P. We've learned some alarming information. Several suspicious items have been purchased by the Doofenshmirtz Corporation. They include

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Come in, Agent P. We've been having trouble with our pipes getting mixed up with the city's dump system. We aren't one hundred percent sure where you'll end up.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I want to apologize for my appearance. You see, I was up all night monitoring Doofenshmirtz. It seems that-- zzzzzzzzzzzz.... Yeah, I'll have cake.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Now for your mission. Slushy the Clown statues have disappeared all over the Tri-State area. Without that clown, there's just nothing fun about lunch anymore.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, there you are, Agent P. I hear you took a wrong tube and ended up over in Wanda's division. Well, Doofenshmirtz has sent you a video message. Take a look.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Garry the Gander? Oh, that's just a wild-goose chase. Get it? Goose, gander? Heh. Uh, we had to distract Agent P because he's too close to Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on monitor in truck) Remember, Carl, nothing distracts kids like ice cream. You need to get rid of those two boys so Agent P can proceed with his mission.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We can't let the family see him like this, he's got the brain of a toddler. We need to restore his memory before he's missed at the Father Daughter Picnic.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sure, sure. Thank you for not making us wait. Huh. That bathroom attendant was lovely, he gave me mints and some floss. I-I just couldn't thank him enough.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I know we gave you some time off, but could you please come back in to work? (pleading) Please? (normal voice) I can't hold my eyes like this much longer.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. I was just doing a little handicapping for this year's Running of the Chinchillas. Think I'm going to box Dryer's Dust with Squeaky Toy.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I trusted that your mission was a complete success. Good work! Now, hand it over for the special disposal procedure. Careful, now. Careful.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! Anyway, Agent P, sources indicate Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to one of his evil schemes. I need you to get out there and put a stop to it. Good luck.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hey, Carl, does my uvula look unusually large to you? (He turns his mirror towards Carl. Just as the ray was to hit him, it bounces off, and hits Carl.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What the..? (at Carl) Hey, Carl! It's back! Look how great it... (moves; realizes the mustache isn't on his face) Oh. (taps the screen) Oh, doggone it!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Happy nine hundredth and ninety ninth lair entrance, Agent P! To commemorate this joyous occasion, we like to present you with this souvenir t-shirt.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, our agents are being overwhelmed by the sheer number of robots coming into our dimension. You must get to Doof's headquarters and stop him!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Come in. Sit down, Agent P. We have a serious problem. It seems that someone, and I'm not saying who, someone has spilled on the couch in the lobby.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, Agent P, who do I look like? Huh, whadaya think? (Perry simply stares) C'mon! Carmen Miranda! Y'know, you really should watch more old movies.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (with lots of unshaven hairs on his face) I can't believe you forgot to pick up new razors, Carl! Now I have to go on camera without a clean shave!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: When an evil scientist sends preread letters wrongdoing can't be far behind. Dismissed Agent P! Carl, let me uh, smell that letter again, would ya?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hey, there, Agent P! Well, it's Horrific Movie Night at my house where a bunch of agency guys get together and make fun of ridiculously bad movies.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I would never pull an elaborate childish prank like that. It would ruin my reputation! Destroy my credita- oh, I see where you're going with this.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! A distress signal! Agent P is really trapped! Why won't he use the bevy of tools and weapons conveniently located in his hat?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Alright, everyone, take it easy. Just calm down. No reason to get upset. We've got a massive security deposit on this place. So, everybody just...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Gets up and walks off-screen) For crying out loud, Carl, (Carl is seen pedaling the generator, panting) pedal faster. I gotta check my E-mail.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, I just completed your intern evaluation report. You've earned a gold star in every category except one. You need to show more initiative.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We still haven't found out who it was. In the meantime, we need you to bring him in. Get on it, Agent P, and, uh, take Doofenshmirtz with you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Really? Hmm. (Takes Carl off for the acrobatic training but comes back to the screen) Oh, yeah, Agent P, uh, stop Doof. (Perry glares at him)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Huh? Great googly moogly! Combining fighting evil with acrobatics? Of course! It was right in front of my face the whole time. That's my boy!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: (on screen) Well, that's impossible. He's right here in our detention facility. I-I-I just played checkers with him. (He cheats, by the way.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, guess we could kiss that pair of handcuffs good bye. I don't about you, but I'm gonna go take in a review. See you back in the States.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Oh, right! Ahem. As you know, after our agents were all captured and OWCA fell, your resistance partly operated out of our old headquarters.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, welcome to our telethon. If you're just joining us, your dollars are helping us to find a cure for, um... antidisestablishmentarianism.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, recent events have brought it to my attention that you're a great help to me. And, uh, not quite sure what I'd do without you, in fact.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Violin and candlestick. (They pose as Gary the Gander flies past them. They jump over some lamps and a desk chair offscreen.) Garden party.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, come on! (to Perry) Sorry, Agent P. Carl's been taking some film classes and now believes I'm stifling his creativity as my cameraman.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: All right, put it up there. (A picture of the princess appears and she has an uncanny resemblance to Candace) Oh, wow, what are the odds?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: As you know, Doofenshmirtz is in the area of the Big Island. He's obviously up to no good. Find out what's he up to and put a stop to it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake, I can see the smell from here. Put it down and test all the outside portals. Maybe the doors are stuck or something.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hehe, pretty nifty, huh? (from the hologram) With this device, you'll be able to contact me anywhere at anytime, but don't call between 3

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry about that, Agent P. Our slide waxing guy has Jury duty this weekend. Anyhow, Doofenshmirtz has purchased some suspicious items

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You came in a little late there, Carl. Get back over there. We'll try it again. (Clears throat) Blah, blah, blah, the power of dance.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. I've got bad news and good news. The bad news is you're being reassigned to a new, more evil villain. His name

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Like I said, we haven't come up with anything yet. So, we need you to get in there, and find out. Good luck, and be careful out there

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You can't make me talk. I have nerves of steel and...an iron will and...gold teeth and a...copper spleen. Basically, I'm 35% metal.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh Agent P, you look adorable as a balloon animal. Now, get out there and laissez le bon temps rouler. ("Let the good times roll.")

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just do it, Carl! And watch the hair. Take these. (Carl gets on Monogram's shoulders and takes the binoculars.) Now what do ya see?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: No, no. Doofenshmirtz is in jail. Everything's fine. Go-Go to your picnic and relax. Dress festive, be young! Ha. You've earned it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, what good are they to him here? Poor Agent P, he's just a platypus trapped in a cage. Wearing a tiny hat, a little fedora...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry, Planty the Potted Plant, but apparently your cover's been blown. I'm afraid you'll have to be repotted with another family.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Um, uh, Doof's doing something in City Hall, uh, put a stop to whatever it is. (running after Carl) Hey Carl, I get the blue one!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (tearing up) Congratulations, Agent P. I knew it couldn't be you causing all that trouble. (sobs) You are officially reinstated.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Happy Birthday, Agent P! (blows into kazoo) (awkward pause) It's not your birthday, is it? (Perry shakes his head) Are we close?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (After spotting a large box of straws) Hmm, that gives me an idea. And this time, a good idea. Not like the one I had about the-

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I do have 24 hours before I have to submit my evaluation. Prove that you can show initiative and that gold star is yours.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P... (Exclaims) Sorry, we haven't cleaned that entrance in a while. Don't worry, we have a moist towelette.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I assure you, for the rest of my life, every time I look back on this I will personally drive over to your house and smack you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, and we're back. We're counting down the top 10 Phineas and Ferb music videos from Season 1, as picked by you, the viewers.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, you made your point, Parenthesis. Apparently, I didn't notice you in school. Sad story. Boo-hoo. But why are you here?

Name: Bad Future Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, another failed mission. It's gotten really hard to defeat Doofenshmirtz ever since we swore that oath to obey him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz was spotted this morning leaving this building with a shopping list. On the list were four items

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: ...a win for him would really stretch my suspension of disbelief. But just in case, you better sit tight and just observe.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good luck, young man! (they leave) We could use someone like him at the Agency. Carl, why don't we have a soundtrack band?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P! What's wrong? Oh! You caught Doofenshmirtz, huh? That's weird. Usually he traps you, then you escape and then...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just trying to put a happy face on it, Carl. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted on a... boat. Go check it out. (Perry leaves)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's better. Sorry to be so harsh, Agent P, but today is a very special day. Your 100th battle with Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P? Agent P? Hello, Agent P? Agent P? (At Carl) Carl, he does know this is scheduled for this morning, doesn't he?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry. We need you to infiltrate his headquarters. Carl thinks I need to be more "inclusive". Find out what he's up to!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry, Agent P. Your monitor is on the fritz today...thanks to someone who isn't aware that croquet is an outdoor game.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Special surveillance photos tells us that Doof is outfitting his skiff with something. It's hard to tell--

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Is everything all right, Agent P? I'm sensing you're in a bit of a jam. Can you get us a better view of the situation?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, this new facility is really impressive. Now, tell me again where you found the money for all these improvements.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hmmm. Nevermind, Carl. It's showtime! (Cut to the stage) Hello, everyone! Welcome to the O.W.C.A. Graduation Ceremony!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, well, look at that. (He hides Carl) Seems they just found a cure. Thanks to all the viewers who donated. Bye now.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I can see that Carl, now get back in that corner until I tell you, you can get up. Fifteen minutes left on the timer.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh no, Agent P, it's stuck in their heads. We need something even more catchy to counteract it. But what could we...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, I'm afraid your robotic Mr. Fletcher is overheating. Apparently, Carl forgot to top off the coolant levels.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Ah, well, I didn't want to say anything before, but we kind of lost track of some of the agents when Doof took over.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The terrain is too treacherous. You're going to have to parachute. Here's your parachute, goggles and oxygen mask.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we were... Wait a minute. (close-up of the zoo platypus) You're not in uniform, agent. Where is your hat?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on wrist communicator) Agent P, Doof found Agent S's weakness. We need you to drop everything and return to duty.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! Is that what I look like?! Wow, suddenly I feel ridiculous. Nevermind, Carl, you can have it.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Yeah, well, um, now that we're trying to rebuild our spy network, I was wondering, um, where did you put the keys?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry about the distraction, Agent P. The ladies are helping to, uh, (reading from a card) "net-roy-er the lair."

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Then something's not right because OWCA is infested with fleas. Carl, activate emergency flea protocol 993-alpha.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P. we, we just found out that Doofenshmirtz is scouring the Tri-State Area for some kind of on-off device.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl? Carl! Oh, no, they must be torturing that poor kid. Don't worry, little unpaid intern, help is on the way.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I can't believe I let myself get talked into this. It's embarrassing and, if I'm being honest, a bit drafty.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we've finished restoring Mr. Fletcher's memory. You need to distract the girl so we can make the swap.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P! Something terrible has happened. Listen carefully; these straws are about to collapse like a flimsy...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. I see you're trying out the new SFU 2000. It's a lot of fun, but don't let your duties slide.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hang tight, Agent P. Backup is on the way. I mean, it would be, if we had some. Uh, I'm gonna make some calls.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Singsong) Mommy-mi-moe-moo. Blah-blah-blah-blah-blah. Me-ma-moe-moo-my-pa. (Clears throat) Ma-moe-mee-ma-moo.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Not yet, Carl. Wait till I'm done here. (to Perry) You are officially.. discharged. (to Carl) Okay, now, Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Right, we think it may be a switch, but we don't know what it's for so, we need your help. Good luck Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You really think you'll be part of all this? He's playing you like a penny whistle in a really bad jazz band.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: La, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la. (clears throat) So, get him, Agent P, and good luck.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello, children. Carl, uh, your mother and I were worried when you didn't come home. Uh, are you in trouble?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes yes, the next fifteen minutes should be a real hoot. Then, of course, Agent P will be sent away forever.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, you're a solid B+ student with a promising future. What could you possibly have to gain from all this?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: All of our other agents are busy out in the field. If-If only there was a way to get these tools to Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P. Come in, Agent P. Oh, good, you're all right. We need your help. OWCA's on lockdown. We're trapped!
